steps.action: Search Negation from the Grammar map; open a result.
steps.expected: The matching reading section opens and navigation remains available.

steps.action: Start a 20-question session; submit one incorrect and nineteen correct answers.
steps.expected: Feedback explains each answer; result is 19/20 with one item to review.

steps.action: Use Tab, arrows, Space, Enter and hint controls through a session.
steps.expected: Selection alone does not submit; focus moves to feedback/next controls; hint controls remain operable.

steps.action: Submit a question, reload, and return to practice.
steps.expected: Checked answers/order/progress are restored; unsubmitted choices are not claimed as saved.

steps.action: Confirm reset of one topic after saving work in two topics.
steps.expected: Only the selected topic resets; cancelling preserves all progress.

steps.action: Load once online and wait for caching; go offline, reload and start practice.
steps.expected: Bundled reading/practice work without remote APIs; external references need connectivity.

steps.action: Open at 390px; select a topic, close the dialog with Escape and return.
steps.expected: No horizontal overflow; focus returns to the Topics trigger.

steps.action: Enable forced colors/reduced motion; navigate reading and practice.
steps.expected: Focus, checked/incorrect states and controls remain distinguishable.

steps.action: Use VoiceOver to select, check, review and advance questions.
steps.expected: Question, choices, checked result and current action have understandable announcements.

steps.action: Inspect storage/privacy copy; clear browser data in a disposable profile.
steps.expected: The product explains local progress and does not promise cloud backup.

steps.action: Have a qualified reviewer inspect the selected pilot explanations/questions/keys.
steps.expected: Record the actual scope/date and corrections; do not infer approval from automated checks.

steps.action: An approved tutor/learner tries the reviewed topic and later returns.
steps.expected: Record observed usefulness, errors and supported return evidence without claiming calibrated proficiency.
